# hirepulse

> Selected HirePulse Apify Actors (15 public Actors verified October 22, 2026): AliExpress search results, Google Ads by domain, company buying-intent signals, ATS job boards, Google Jobs, keyword search volume, domain SEO overview, YouTube transcripts, website tech stack, ATS detector, company contacts finder, B2B account research agent, AI visibility radar, MCP x402 server grader, and store to LLMs generator. Every tool returns clean JSON. All of them run on the Apify Store (https://apify.com/hirepulse). You pay per use and there is no subscription. Higher Apify plans get volume discounts.

Full details for every tool (input fields and a real output record): https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/llms-full.txt
Every tool page and guide also has a plain Markdown version at the same address with ".md", for example https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/aliexpress-search-api.md

## Connect an AI agent (MCP)

- Remote MCP server, one tool: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/<tool-id>`
- Several tools at once, comma-separated: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper,hirepulse/ats-job-pulse`
- Authentication: OAuth in the browser, or the header `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>`.
- Local (stdio): `npx -y @apify/actors-mcp-server --tools hirepulse/<tool-id>`, with `APIFY_TOKEN` in `env`.
- REST API: `POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/hirepulse~<tool-id>/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=<APIFY_TOKEN>`, with the tool's input as a JSON body.

## Tools

- [AliExpress Search Scraper](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/aliexpress-search-api/): `hirepulse/aliexpress-search-scraper`. AliExpress search results for any query; choose currency and ship-to country; 60 products per page. Fields: product_id, title, url, image_url, price, original_price, discount_percent, currency, rating, sold, sold_text, is_sponsored, listed_since, ship_to. It does NOT return the store or seller name, shipping costs or delivery estimates, reviews or stock. Price: $2.50 per 1,000 products. Free Apify plan: 100 products per run.
- [Google Ads Transparency Scraper](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/google-ads-transparency-api/): `hirepulse/google-ads-transparency-scraper`. Every Google ad a company runs, by domain. Fields include advertiser_name, advertiser_id, advertiser_verified, ad_id, format (text/image/video), first and last shown dates, preview image and Transparency Center link. Summary mode returns one row per domain. Has an "only new ads" monitoring mode. Price: $0.005 per domain + $0.0015 per ad. Domains with no ads cost $0.
- [Company Intent Radar](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/company-intent-signals-api/): `hirepulse/company-intent-radar`. Per company domain: open jobs and new jobs in the last 30 days (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee), Google ads running now and total ads, organic traffic and SEO trend, email provider from MX records, a 0-100 intent score and a one-line summary. Price: $0.03 per company report, charged only when the full report was produced. Free plan: hiring and email signals for 5 companies.
- [ATS Job Scraper](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/ats-jobs-api/): `hirepulse/ats-job-pulse`. All open jobs from a company's Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee or SmartRecruiters board, by domain (for example stripe.com) or board slug. Workday is not supported. Job fields: title, department, location, is_remote, posted_date, salary (where the company publishes it), detected_technologies, apply_url. A company summary row adds total_active_jobs, remote_jobs, new_jobs, closed_jobs, jobs_by_department, top_locations and top_technologies. Price: $0.05 per company whose job board was found and processed, however many jobs it has. Companies that are not found, and failed ones, are not charged.
- [Google Jobs Scraper](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/google-jobs-api/): `hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper`. Google Jobs results for any search, in 90+ countries, for a whole country or one city with a radius. Fields: title, company, location, salary text plus salary_min, salary_max, salary_currency and salary_period when shown, contract_type, posted_at, posted_ago, source, apply_url. Price: $0.005 per search that returns jobs + $0.001 per job.
- [Keyword Search Volume](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/keyword-search-volume-api/): `hirepulse/keyword-search-volume`. Google monthly search volume, CPC, competition and keyword ideas. Fields include keyword, search_volume, cpc_usd, competition, competition_level, keyword_difficulty, search_intent and trend_monthly_pct/trend_quarterly_pct/trend_yearly_pct. Price: $0.03 per lookup + $0.005 per keyword result. Free plan: real volume, CPC and difficulty for the first 3 keywords of each run (the free preview depends on availability and can be paused).
- [Domain SEO public-evidence preview](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/domain-seo-overview-api/): `hirepulse/domain-seo-overview`. Inspect website titles, meta descriptions, sitemap observations and Google Autocomplete suggestions. Native mode does not measure organic traffic, ranking positions, keyword search volumes or CPC; unavailable metrics remain null. Native/public-evidence mode emits no domain-lookup or domain-result charges. An Actor start event is still listed at $0.00005 per GB (minimum one event), and applicable Apify charges may apply. Review the live Pricing tab. Paid SEO-database events are separate and are not activated by this example.
- [YouTube Transcript Scraper](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/youtube-transcript-api/): `hirepulse/youtube-transcript-scraper`. Transcripts of YouTube videos in bulk, with timestamps. Fields: video_id, url, title, channel, duration_seconds, language, is_auto_generated, transcript, word_count, segments. Free plan: the first 3 videos of each run. Price: $0.003 per delivered transcript. Videos without captions, unavailable videos and failed fetches are not charged.
- [Website Tech Stack Detector](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/website-tech-stack-api/): `hirepulse/website-tech-stack-detector`. Enrich company domains with observed website technologies, advertising pixels, frontend frameworks, and DNS MX email signals. Fast plain-HTTP inspection. Price: $0.005 per domain checked + $0.001 per detected tech. Domains with no stack cost $0.
- [ATS Detector](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/ats-detector-api/): `hirepulse/ats-detector`. Detect which applicant tracking system a company uses (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, etc.) and extract official careers board endpoints. Price: $0.005 per domain checked. Undetected boards cost $0.
- [Company Contacts Finder](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/company-contacts-api/): `hirepulse/company-contact-details-finder`. Publicly listed corporate emails, inquiry forms, phone numbers, and official social media profiles from company websites. Price: $0.005 per domain checked + $0.001 per public contact found.
- [B2B Account Research Agent](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/b2b-account-research-api/): `hirepulse/b2b-account-research-agent`. Autonomous account intelligence combining careers hiring velocity, web technology stack, Google ads presence, and verified digital footprint into a structured dossier. Price: $0.05 per company research dossier produced.
- [AI Search Brand Visibility Radar](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/ai-visibility-radar/): `hirepulse/ai-search-brand-visibility-radar`. Inspect website robots directives, crawler access, and AI engine headers. Audit llms.txt, JSON-LD structured data, and semantic discoverability for Perplexity, ChatGPT, and Claude crawlers. Price: $0.02 per returned report.
- [MCP & x402 Server Grader](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/mcp-x402-grader/): `hirepulse/mcp-x402-server-grader`. Inspect live MCP tool catalogs and schema completeness. Benchmark tool call token efficiency and verify x402 payment headers. Price: $0.01 per returned evidence report.
- [Store to LLMs Generator](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/store-to-llms-generator/): `hirepulse/shopify-to-llms-generator`. Sample public store feeds and generate clean, standardized llms.txt markdown with product titles, pricing, variants, and specs. Price: $0.02 per report with products.
